topic: Day 28 — carousel — Integrity is a practiced consistency, not a personality trait

slides.text:
Integrity isn't a [trait].
It's a practice.
Nobody is naturally honest across every situation.
It's rebuilt one small choice at a time.
Every kept word is an actual rep toward it.

caption:
Nobody is naturally honest across every situation. Integrity is a practiced consistency, rebuilt one small choice at a time.

Follow for one of these a day.
